# Wave.com Cloned Pages (SharePoint & Standalone HTML/CSS)

Clean, pixel-perfect, self-contained static HTML/CSS clones of [Wave.com](https://www.wave.com):

- `index.html` — Homepage (`/en/`)
- `business.html` — Wave Business (`/en/business/`)
- `about.html` — About Us (`/en/about/`)
- `careers.html` — Careers (`/en/careers/`)
- `blog.html` — Blog (`/en/blog/`)

## Features
- **Zero local dependencies**: All GT Walsheim & Inter fonts, icons, background patterns, and logos use absolute HTTPS URLs.
- **SharePoint-ready**: Compatible with SharePoint Modern Script Editor, Content Editor, and Embed web parts.
- **Interactive**: Bootstrap carousel and pure JavaScript job filters work out of the box.
